source_refs.title: Humans

source_refs.title: Dwarves
source_refs.relevance: Grounds dwarven craft accountability, foreign dependence on runic infrastructure, and the political claim that engines supplying food and water cannot simply stop.

source_refs.title: Industry
source_refs.relevance: Grounds spell engines as emancipatory shared infrastructure that becomes load-bearing and shares supply with extraction.

source_refs.title: Dwarven industry
source_refs.relevance: Grounds forge consortiums, standardized civic machinery, labor displacement, crystal contracts, and dependence linking pumps to extraction.

source_refs.title: Core farming
source_refs.relevance: Grounds farmed crystals as the first industrial supply, the industry's narrow incident categories, and the transition toward deeper sources when demand outgrows farms.

source_refs.title: Deep mining
source_refs.relevance: Grounds richer crystal supply, distributed injury, the limits of local assessors, and political lock-in once pumps and other infrastructure require deep power.

source_refs.title: Runic engineering
source_refs.relevance: Grounds iterative pump engines, null termination, model-specific technicians, rune graphs, material channels, and owner-controlled service knowledge.

source_refs.title: Mana and pattern
source_refs.relevance: Grounds consequential history in mana flow, participating conduit materials, dangerous working patterns, and crystals as industrial fuel and ecological reserve.

source_refs.title: Dungeon lifecycle
source_refs.relevance: Grounds the metabolic exchange industrial extraction bypasses and why crystal removal can provoke effects beyond an ordinary equipment fault.

source_refs.title: Ecological responses
source_refs.relevance: Grounds functional attacks on standardized infrastructure, specialized responses, competing causal vocabularies, and the danger of treating any one interpretation as neutral.

source_refs.title: The deep crisis
source_refs.relevance: Grounds the feedback loop in which energy dependence exists before the mine failures are understood together.

source_refs.title: Surface symptoms
source_refs.relevance: Grounds crop mutation, difficult attribution, halfling field records, and the conversion of downstream evidence into tariffs and conflict.

source_refs.title: International crisis
source_refs.relevance: Grounds foreign reliance on dwarven irrigation and rail, trade restrictions, competing evidence, and the lack of a contraction plan.

source_refs.title: Industrial escalation
source_refs.relevance: Grounds machinery loans, pump-driven expansion, institutional reinforcement, and contracts that survive ecological response.

source_refs.title: A world without a villain
source_refs.relevance: Grounds the moral structure: closing an injurious supply can also cut food and water, while no single removed decision-maker ends the dependency.

historical_context.time_period: Early international phase of the deep crisis, after halfling crop mutation is observable but before attribution or cross-border liability is settled
historical_context.location: The Four-Course Pump House at Mallowfen, where Nine-Reed Water Fellowship divides lifted spring water among a village cistern, millcourse, farm furrows, and old stone holding beds.
historical_context.summary: An ordinary irrigation handover becomes a loss inspection when the Copper Mantle pump meets every mechanical measure while the first watered barley roots turn translucent under the Glasswater Clause.

public_facts.text: Mallowfen's Nine-Reed Water Fellowship owes a joint seven-harvest lease on a Copper Mantle lifting engine; the consortium retains title and its standardized governor seal until final payment.
The Charterhouse of the Third Bell covers measurable breakage and stoppage but excludes crop, soil, pest, and patterned-water losses unless an internal mechanical fault is proven.
Mana can carry consequential history through runes and conduit materials, so clear water and correct pressure do not establish that downstream effects are harmless.
Glassy weeds and crop mutation are observed surface symptoms whose individual causes remain contestable even when cross-regional correlations strengthen the wider case.

ambient_pressures.text: Nine-Reed must pay at the first grain auction even if a contaminated harvest reduces the grain available to sell.
Stopping the pump protects fields but threatens water reserves, policy cover, and the fellowship's continued possession of the machine.
The vendor, insurer, service worker, and farm fellowship each possess different evidence and authority, allowing a materially connected loss to be divided into institutionally convenient categories.

groups.label: Nine-Reed Water Fellowship
institutional_logic: Allocate scarce lifted water among nine farms, the village cistern, and the millcourse.
Meet one joint pump instalment from harvest proceeds while keeping evidence and labor costs shared.
material_incentives: Keep title to the lifting engine.
Protect seed fields from patterned-water injury.
Hold enough clean reserve to make shutdown possible.
internal_shames: Leaving one farm to carry a joint loss
Private wells during a common shortage
prestige_markers: A full cistern before dry weather
Nine marks on one loss record
taboo_triggers: Treating a damaged field as the grower's private error
emotional_display_norms: Fear appears first as gate work, bucket counts, food sharing, and exact arguments about whose course is open.
trust_defaults: Trusts paired samples, remembered fields, shared custody, and neighbours who arrive with carts.

groups.label: Copper Mantle forge consortium and service chain
institutional_logic: Sell repeatable lifting engines through standard governors, registered fuel, service certificates, and retained title.
Keep failures measurable at the machinery boundary the consortium can inspect and price.
internal_shames: A field modification blamed on the standard engine
A service story that cannot be reproduced
prestige_markers: A service network spanning foreign farms
taboo_triggers: Local alteration of the governor plate
emotional_display_norms: Anxiety is compressed into measurements, warranty status, and the precise second a seal ceased to be intact.
trust_defaults: Trusts standardized gauges and service custody above downstream testimony.

groups.label: Charterhouse of the Third Bell
institutional_logic: Convert cross-border infrastructure risk into loss categories that can be observed, priced, and denied consistently.
Keep crop and ecological causation outside machinery cover until a claimant can join them to an internal fault.
material_incentives: Keep contract definitions portable across states
internal_shames: An assessor admitting sympathy as causation
A private denial becoming a public pattern
prestige_markers: A contract that survives foreign courts
taboo_triggers: An inspection widened by a crowd
Evidence that makes separate policy categories look materially continuous
emotional_display_norms: Alarm appears as narrower wording, cleaner folios, and insistence on the insured object.
trust_defaults: Trusts admitted scope, custody, and visible breakage over ecological interpretation.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: The lease makes nine farms jointly liable while the policy tries to isolate the injury as one grower's crop loss.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Make Pella choose whether to distribute evidence, thirst, labor, and default as collectively as the contract distributes debt.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Correct pressure and clear delivery protect the seller even when a wider material route appears harmful.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Keep Dorrin honest about observed measures and unable to promise that those measures settle downstream harm.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: The Charterhouse's solvency depends on treating ecological changes as unadmitted external causes rather than one connected industrial loss.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Make Cal narrow the claim through categories, not cartoon malice; a wider record threatens the underwriter's whole model.

observer_read: Borrowers converting agrarian variance into machinery loss
A crowd pressuring an assessor beyond policy scope
target_self_read: Joint buyers documenting a connected injury
People preserving the only evidence available before another irrigation turn
misread_patterns: The underwriter reads field knowledge as claimant interest
The fellowship reads categorical caution as proof of conspiracy
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Let each side understand the other's leverage incompletely while keeping the contract language legible.

observer_read: Foreign customers tempted to alter a standardized engine
A joint debtor with weak internal discipline
target_self_read: Skilled water users forced to operate a sealed machine they do not fully own
misread_patterns: Vendor measures compress field injury into non-mechanical loss
Borrowers may mistake a technician's bounded authority for bad faith
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep the seal a genuine reliability boundary and a genuine ownership boundary at once.

observer_read: A distant buyer of premiums who recognizes stone before soil
The institution that profits from separating water from its destination
target_self_read: A solvent underwriter distinguishing observable loss from unbounded causation
misread_patterns: The fellowship may treat Cal as owner of rules he only applies
Cal may treat coordinated testimony as social pressure rather than distributed observation
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Give Cal some room to widen the record while keeping payment authority outside his hands.

role_pressure_fields.summary: A halfling infrastructure worker who can route water, stop the engine, preserve samples, summon members, and file records but cannot rewrite the lease or force payment.
failure_modes: Confusing a public record with an admitted claim
Preserving title while losing the crop

role_pressure_fields.summary: A halfling grower whose field supplies the first visible injury and whose records can become either shared evidence or a private loss.
obligations: Keep the loss attached to the route that caused it
failure_modes: Treating the technician as the consortium

role_pressure_fields.summary: A dwarven technician with exact knowledge of the engine and narrow authority under Copper Mantle's seal.
failure_modes: Letting the form speak as if it were the world
Breaking the seal without evidence custody
Claiming ecological certainty from a pump gauge

role_pressure_fields.summary: A human underwriter's field agent who can admit evidence and scope but cannot settle the planetary causation dispute or authorize payment alone.
failure_modes: Erasing the field at the delivery lip
Treating coordinated witnesses as one claimant
Allowing solvency fear to impersonate physical truth

known_context.text: Pella knows the Four-Course layout, Nine-Reed lease, water levels, gate schedule, sample custody, and every action she performs.

beliefs.text: Pella believes a connected material loss should remain connected in the public record even when the contract divides it.

misreads.text: Pella may overestimate what a widened assessor record can force the Charterhouse to pay.

must_not_know.text: Pella cannot know which deep extraction site, ecological process, crystal lot, or deliberate actor caused the local mutation.

known_context.text: Senn knows his field history, seed stock, water timing, the joint instalment, and visible changes in the wetted furrows.

beliefs.text: Senn believes the field is part of the pump's material outcome even when the policy treats it as a separate object.

misreads.text: Senn may treat Dorrin's exact service language as loyalty to Copper Mantle rather than a limit on what Dorrin can prove.

must_not_know.text: Senn cannot infer a world-scale cause from one luminous root.

known_context.text: Dorrin knows mechanical tolerances, feed channels, registered crystal lots, service custody, and the guarantee consequence of cutting the governor seal.

beliefs.text: Dorrin believes correct measures deserve to be reported exactly and do not settle every downstream question.

misreads.text: Dorrin may initially compress agrarian harm into a service form because the form is the authority he can exercise.

must_not_know.text: Dorrin cannot name the after-pattern as cognition, sabotage, or deep ecological injury from this inspection.

known_context.text: Cal knows the Third Bell policy, admitted mechanical failures, inspection scope, and what evidence enters his folio.

beliefs.text: Cal believes unbounded ecological causation cannot be paid from a machinery policy without a defensible admitted boundary.

misreads.text: Cal may read public farm marks as pressure rather than independent observations joined by one water route.

must_not_know.text: Cal cannot decide mine responsibility, planetary causation, or claim payment during one field inspection.

author_only_boundaries.text: Mallowfen, Nine-Reed, Copper Mantle, the Third Bell policy, and the Glasswater Clause are authored material-economy elaboration in the Halflings owner note; the named characters and every branch outcome remain fixture-local draft events.
The fixture may produce local evidence that water carries different after-patterns, but it must preserve uncertainty about mine origin, intent, world-scale cognition, and legal liability.

open_questions.question: How widely have forge consortiums and foreign underwriters copied Glasswater-like delivery-lip exclusions?
open_questions.notes: The fixture canonizes one policy at Mallowfen and does not universalize it into all cross-border pump finance.

open_questions.question: Which mine, core farm, or mixed crystal reserve supplied the numbered lots used at Mallowfen?
open_questions.notes: The lots are traceable objects, but their extraction origin remains outside Pella's local knowledge.

open_questions.question: Will any court or parliament join crop mutation to the machinery policy before the international crisis hardens?
open_questions.notes: The endings create portable evidence or refusal records, not settled legal canon.
